criteria: Definition of Redis Cache Failover and Degradation Strategy.
hint: Specify whether the system falls back to querying the primary MongoDB layer (risking heavy query latency) or safely degrades functionality if the Redis cluster drops offline during peak End-of-Month usage.

references.info: Redis is marked CRITICAL for achieving sub-5-minute data latency metrics and fast UI toggling.

additional_info: Without a fallback strategy, a Redis OOM (Out of Memory) crash will take down the entire reporting frontend.

criteria: Specification of AWS S3 Data Retention and Lifecycle Policies.
hint: Determine the exact expiration timeline for temporarily generated PDF/CSV artifacts (e.g., auto-delete after 24 hours vs 7 days) to prevent infinite S3 storage cost ballooning.

references.info: AWS S3 is used for short-lived temporary storage of generated PDF/CSV export snapshots.

additional_info: Critical for DevOps to configure Terraform/AWS Bucket policies before deployment.

criteria: Data Encryption Strategy 'At Rest' for High-Value Revenue Metrics.
hint: Specify whether Field-Level Encryption or simple Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) is required within MongoDB for the fetched CRM revenue nodes.

references.info: System persists massive sets of sales records / Booked-Billed Revenue into MongoDB.

additional_info: While RBAC protects data in transit and UI, data at rest must be explicitly scoped for compliance (e.g., SOC2).
